title: Use Bankrbot to buy and lock $home
description:
Buy and lock at least $1 worth of $HOME on Base using @bankrbot directly on the timeline.

You can complete the bounty on either X or Farcaster. One submission per platform.

$HOME is the token launched to help fund Based House, with 100% of creator fees allocated to the residency program.

$HOME token
Contract address:

0xB9A1E52f3ED678B01Ff5e256fDe43f26f9C01bA3

DEXscreener:

https://dexscreener.com/base/0xcfa6173616804aa9974bf7a648149a98b5ce64251f3ed0b9852dd3dc0d8caa24

Make sure you are buying the correct $HOME token on Base.

Requirements
To qualify:

Make a public post on X or Farcaster using @bankrbot to buy  and lock at least $1 worth of $HOME.

The purchase must be executed through Bankr as part of the public timeline interaction.Your post must remain publicly viewable.

Submit a screenshot showing your Bankr interaction and successful purchase as your poidh claim.
Include a link to the original X or Farcaster post in your claim description.

The transaction must be verifiable onchain.

Only purchases made after this bounty is published are eligible. 

Deadline to submit a claim: Submission open until mc reaches 5m

About $HOME
$HOME was launched on Base to help fund Based House Mumbai. Track progress on seedme.xyz.

Learn more through the official $HOME / Based House Mumbai announcement: https://x.com/homebasedotlove/status/2095444222090592396
